reader_summary.overview: This week's Summer Series is another twofer, Dawn Fitzpatrick from Soros and Steve Rattner from Willett Advisors, Michael Bloomberg's family office. We packaged these two leading single-family offices together to hear their different approaches to a similar investment challenge. Please enjoy my conversations with Dawn Fitzpatrick and Steve Rattner, both from 2019.
